description: Agent Readiness: submit the rule set an operator plans to hand an agent, by area (spending limits, approval gates, accountability owner, recourse and refund handling, logging), as fields or as the rules in words. The signed report gives each area ready, thin or missing against the situations an agent meets in its first week (a large payment, payments adding up, an unanswered approval, an absent owner, a refund request, a dispute, a wrong payment, a request for what it did and why), naming each one the rules do not cover and the smallest addition that closes it. Spending policy controls are wever_spending-policy-check. Verdict not_ready, ready_with_gaps or ready. POST /api/adoption-readiness-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-readiness-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-readiness/.
